title: Sorting out the chronology and when he reached Kansas City
summary: Goodwin and Smith untangle Lovett's order of bands, Thamon Hayes and George Lee, and settle that he arrived by 1922-23.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs

blocks.x: Yeah. In the early thirties Baby Lovett and I were playing together in a band called Thaman Hayes. Now, this was a band that was made up of us fellas who were recently with George Lee's band, Baby Lovett was from George Lee's band, he had started playing with George Lee, right after he left the Rialto Theatre.

Wait, we're jumping ahead a little bit. That's one of the bands I want to cover in detail, that band. Let's see, we haven't even discussed George Lee yet, and he came before Thaman Thayman Hayes, right?
